# Kiki

Scientific research on physics-structured sparse reduced-order models for IEEE39
post-fault dynamics, with transient prediction, stability and modal-analysis objectives.

GitHub repository: [LLzijian/grid-transient-rom](https://github.com/LLzijian/grid-transient-rom)
(https://github.com/LLzijian/grid-transient-rom.git).

## Start here

- [研究报告阅读入口](reports/README.md)：先看[当前静态拓扑与隐幅值调制研究](campaigns/gftd_kuramoto_discovery_20261106.md)，再按问题追溯结论、审查和执行。早期材料从主题档案进入。
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): top-level research principles, aesthetics, authority and
  navigation. Rules are not experiment logs.
- [kiki.md](kiki.md): scientific task design — deployment contract, data/information
  boundary, metric definitions and capability layers. Current model instances live separately.
- [docs/architecture_design.md](docs/architecture_design.md): first-level learning problem, physical assumptions, identifiability and competing explanations.
- [docs/current_design.md](docs/current_design.md): versioned current architecture, separate from the deployment contract.
- [designs/](designs/README.md): algorithm specifications and revisions; superseded designs live in designs/history/.
- [agents/runtime.md](agents/runtime.md): task ownership, model identity, dependencies and resource scheduling.
- [docs/engineering_loop.md](docs/engineering_loop.md): Campaign → Run → Job tree,
  optimization adequacy vs mechanism evidence, three independent decisions,
  stop/extend and review.
- [docs/research_policy.md](docs/research_policy.md): evidence standards, dual archives,
  budgets, Git archival and the minimal release package.
- [campaigns/](campaigns/): one card per scientific hypothesis, its Run tree and beliefs.
- [docs/current_state.md](docs/current_state.md): current snapshot, pointers to the
  active campaign/run, evidence and next executable action.

After each execution that changes a design, implementation or experimental result,
selectively commit and push the key decisions, decisive results and reproduction
information to GitHub — accepted, rejected, failed or unresolved alike. Keep disposable
intermediate data, private data and raw artifacts local. Follow
[docs/research_policy.md](docs/research_policy.md) §6.

Read historical reports only as needed; reports, results and experiment artifacts hold
the scientific evidence. This README does not duplicate agent rules or current status.

## Closure equation discovery study

The finite A–E implementation and study are documented in the [final report](reports/closure_discovery_20261017_final.md), with [explicit equations and an independent NumPy package](results/closure_discovery_20261017/E/packages/main_2701/README.md). Prediction, structure recovery and stability findings retain their reported scope.

## Historical closure training

The previous closure study used [experiments/train_closure.py](experiments/train_closure.py). Its [GPU training guide](reports/history/docs/gpu_training.md) retains that model's setup, resume procedure and measured performance. Current execution follows the active Campaign and Run protocol; historical experiments retain their original runners and frozen evidence.

## Repository

- src/kiki/: model, data and evaluation code.
- experiments/: scientific experiment and diagnostic entry points.
- tests/: targeted implementation checks.
- configs/: experiment/data/release configuration.
- reports/: experimental results, analyses, reviews and their frozen source records.
- designs/: algorithm specifications; designs/history/ preserves earlier designs.
- docs/: six core documents for design methods, workflow, evidence policy, harness maintenance, current design and current state.
- campaigns/: campaign hypothesis cards, Run plans and new protocols.
- templates/: campaign, run protocol, run closure and mechanism card templates.

Scientific validity takes priority over benchmark improvement. Development results,
implementation QA and model promotion are distinct. Frozen-test access follows the
registered final evaluation procedure; opening the repository does not authorize it.

## Offline harness checks

The v2 harness keeps the existing Campaign/Run/Job and three decisions. It adds
architecture design, separate optimization-health/adequacy records, confirmation
independent of promotion, and advisory task scheduling. It does not resume paused
science or dispatch models. See [runtime](agents/runtime.md).

```bash
python3 tools/research_harness.py check --root .
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_harness_*.py"
```

Examples are synthetic or explicitly dated repository snapshots, never live authorization.

Integration and local verification: [2026-10-30 harness v2 record](reports/harness_v2_integration_20261030.md).

Algorithm-specific designs belong in [designs/](designs/README.md), linked from
campaigns/ and docs/current_design.md. Earlier algorithms are indexed in the
[design archive](designs/history/README.md); results and supporting snapshots remain
in the [report archive](reports/history/docs/README.md). Frozen historical protocols
retain their source identity. The static checker verifies the
[documentation migration map](harness/documentation_migration_20261108.json) and hashes.

# 初代暂态模型：模块选择、能量筛查与误差诊断

**这组研究留下了三个可继续使用的认识：模块需要与重新拟合的主干按同一尺度比较；局部能量候选不能替代稳定性证明；预测误差需要通过物理对照定位，不能由拟合损失或平均分数解释。**

这里整理 2026-09-04 至 09-08 的 E 系列及其后续纠正，沿用 09-22 保留审计确认的解释。
本页是 2026-11-08 补建的历史综述，不是新实验或当前模型采用决定。当前路线见[当前研究状态](../../../docs/current_state.md)。

## 先看这四个问题

| 问题 | 后续记录支持的认识 | 优先阅读 |
|---|---|---|
| 加入记忆模块，是否在所有交叉验证组都值得采用？ | 修正总采用门后，F1/F3/F5 采用模块，F2/F4 回退主干；五组交叉验证的结果不能写成所有组都采用。 | [五组重拟合验收](originals/accepted/0009_five_fold_refit_acceptance.md) |
| 有能量函数、找到鞍点，就能判断稳定吗？ | 旧算法取得的是局部可行能量候选，未建立逃逸边界的有效下界；保留启发式筛查，撤回正式证书解释。 | [候选能量与稳定性证书的区别](originals/accepted/0002_candidate_energy_not_certificate.md) |
| 旧频率精度和 test 表能否直接用作成果？ | 模态须使用最终模型与全部指派对；旧 test 已被消费，继续保留为探索性记录。 | [评价协议修正](originals/accepted/0003_holdout_lifecycle_and_modal_reporting.md)、[综合审计](../../accepted/0010_project_conclusion_audit.md) |
| 大误差主要是积分步长、Pm 输入，还是隐状态初值？ | 在当时冻结模型和对照范围内，缩小步长、给定真实未来 Pm、改用零隐初值均不足以消除主要误差；电气信息有解释价值，尚未唯一定位缺失机制。 | [积分与输入对照](originals/accepted/0011_failure_mechanism_diagnosis.md)、[隐初值对照](originals/accepted/0012_force_balance_diagnosis.md)、[电气功率对照](originals/accepted/0013_electrical_substitution_audit.md) |

## 模块选择：把比较口径与模型精度分开

早期 E2 形成了“主干拟合 → 候选模块提议 → 联合拟合 → 整块删除”的实现与开发记录。
后续增加了总采用门：最终候选必须相对重新拟合的主干，取得至少 2% 的标准化 val 损失改善，且滚动失败率不增加。
删除某一模块不利于局部结果，并不自动说明整个模块模型优于主干。[采用门修正](originals/accepted/0001_pruning_horizons_and_module_adoption.md)

随后发现，模型保存后没有保留训练归一化尺度，导致一次 F1 比较使用了不同分母。
该次结果被拒绝；修复保存和载入后重新比较，接受 F1 重跑。**这里接受的是同口径比较下的结果，不能把两次不同尺度的分数写成模型性能改进。**
[被拒绝的尺度比较](originals/failed/0007_f1_prune_validation_scale_roundtrip.md) → [修复后的 F1 重跑](originals/accepted/0008_f1_prune_rerun_acceptance.md) → [完整重拟合验收](originals/accepted/0009_five_fold_refit_acceptance.md)

完整重拟合按 F1–F5 分成五组，每次用对应的 val 评价。其历史采用结果为：

| 比较组 | 当时的模块采用决定 | H100 合格／声明 val 样本 | 最终 pooled R² |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| F1 | 采用 6 个可选实例 | 34／43 | 0.765788 |
| F2 | 回退重新拟合的主干 | 32／37 | 0.713422 |
| F3 | 采用 5 个可选实例 | 34／42 | 0.857565 |
| F4 | 回退重新拟合的主干 | 38／43 | 0.676278 |
| F5 | 采用 6 个可选实例 | 39／47 | -1.698347 |

来源：[0009 验收原表](originals/accepted/0009_five_fold_refit_acceptance.md)。H100 指 100 个积分区间、101 个采样点，实际终点约 1 s。
此处 pooled R² 沿用原报告合并角度与转速的定义，不是带统一物理单位的 RMSE。
合格的 177 个样本全部稳定，排除的 35 个样本全部失稳；这张表不能表示失稳样本的固定时长预测能力。

这组结果说明了“采用门通过”和“绝对预测精度足够”是两个判断；F5 的结果也完整进入了接受的数值记录。
[综合审计](../../accepted/0010_project_conclusion_audit.md)进一步限定：这些是用于选择后的 val 诊断，不能替代独立 test 确认。

## 能量与模态：保留数值观察，采用修正后的解释

**能量筛查。** 旧 E4/E6/E8 使用局部约束优化和不完整鞍点搜索构造能量裕度。
后续审查指出，局部可行值给出的界方向不足以证明稳定区域；旧“证书 PASS／获证判稳”退出有效解释。
历史 51 个失稳样本中没有被筛为稳定的观察仍被保留，但独立来源／故障线路组只有 9 个，不能转述为零风险保证。
[原问题与修正推导](originals/accepted/0002_candidate_energy_not_certificate.md)

**模态对应。** E5/E5b/E5c 的旧标题采用过每事件最佳匹配及旧模型。
修正诊断使用最终模型，保留完整指派中的全部匹配对，再按事件汇总。
177 个稳定合格事件中 167 个计算成功、10 个失败；成功事件的频率相对误差汇总值为 19.49%、阻尼比绝对误差为 0.07537、MAC 为 0.37647。
这些指标各有定义，不能与旧“7.2%／0.04”标题作同口径升降比较，也不能将失败事件算作已覆盖。
[模态协议](originals/accepted/0003_holdout_lifecycle_and_modal_reporting.md)、[结果与分母](../../accepted/0010_project_conclusion_audit.md)

**test 使用。** 旧 315 事件 build 经 E6b/E6c/E8 多次使用，已退出确认性用途。
整理可以保留全部旧记录，不能恢复这个 build 的独立性。[访问与用途修正](originals/accepted/0003_holdout_lifecycle_and_modal_reporting.md)

## 接受与未接受：各自在研究中留下了什么

下面列的是当时有出处的决定。`accepted/`、`failed/` 只是原存放位置，不代替这些决定的对象与范围。

| 当时的处理 | 材料及用途 | 此后如何使用 |
|---|---|---|
| 接受实现／解释修正 | [物理时域与总采用门](originals/accepted/0001_pruning_horizons_and_module_adoption.md)、[证书语义](originals/accepted/0002_candidate_energy_not_certificate.md)、[test／模态口径](originals/accepted/0003_holdout_lifecycle_and_modal_reporting.md) | 理解原实验口径；不等于采用当前模型 |
| 接受数值记录 | [F1 重跑](originals/accepted/0008_f1_prune_rerun_acceptance.md)、[五组重拟合](originals/accepted/0009_five_fold_refit_acceptance.md) | 保留正、负和回退结果；0008 的局部过强解释以 0009 为准 |
| 接受诊断证据，未晋升预测器 | [容量与积分检查](originals/accepted/0011_failure_mechanism_diagnosis.md)、[力平衡](originals/accepted/0012_force_balance_diagnosis.md)、[电气功率替换](originals/accepted/0013_electrical_substitution_audit.md) | 区分竞争解释；未来真值只用于离线诊断 |
| 拒绝不合法比较 | [归一化尺度遗漏](originals/failed/0007_f1_prune_validation_scale_roundtrip.md) | 保存错误原因、纠正方法和被撤回的比较 |
| 未采用候选，保留结果 | [真实 Pm 电气重拟合](originals/failed/0014_causal_pm_integral_refit.md) | 该次登记精度门未通过；不外推为 Pm 动态无用 |
| 未采用候选，保留结果 | [因果隐初态学习](originals/failed/0015_learned_initial_storage.md) | 平均指标改善但尾部恶化，未通过预设门；不外推为隐初态无法学习 |
| 未采用候选，保留结果 | [动力学与隐初态联合优化](originals/failed/0016_joint_rollout_refinement.md) | 该次 H100 尾部门未通过；原记录转向后续私有模型研究，不是当前待执行指令 |

其中 0011 对纯正弦耦合、固定机械输入的模型检查了割集容量必要条件，并将 F1 的部分平衡点失败定位为该冻结模型的静态不可行。
同一诊断中，F5 通过所检验的静态容量条件，却仍有大动态误差。因此这两类问题被分开处理。
后续电气功率替换的观察提供了下一步检查方向，没有把真实未来电气量变成部署输入。

# 早期私有模型：机械功率、记忆闭合与结构诊断

**这条研究线从统一数据合同上的 M2／M3 基线出发，逐步检查机械功率动态、记忆状态、初始化、能量边界和模态对应。接受记录与未采用方案共同构成证据；它们分别回答具体条件下的问题，不能合成一次模型族的整体成功或失败。**

本页于 2026-11-08 追溯整理，覆盖原 Loop0017–0106 及相关 TASK1／TASK2 材料。前批收拢 Loop0017–0097，本批补上后续联合训练与初始化研究的阅读入口。
早期协议包含 50 ms 等不同部署版本；原协议是历史来源，当前合同与授权以 [kiki.md](../../../kiki.md) 和[当前研究状态](../../../docs/current_state.md)为准。

## 从科学问题进入

| 问题 | 这组材料留下的认识 | 先读哪些记录 |
|---|---|---|
| 数据可用于研究，是否意味着模型已通过？ | smoke／Pilot 接受的是数据链与 QA；M2 接受为比较基准，M3 的机械功率贡献通过当时的 val 筛选。三种接受对象各不相同。 | [数据链](originals/accepted/0017_private_smoke.md)、[Pilot](originals/accepted/0018_private_pilot.md)、[M2](originals/accepted/0019_private_m2.md)、[M3](originals/accepted/0020_private_m3_pm.md) |
| 能从残差找到低维量，是否就能得到自主闭合？ | 初态的非因果对照显示初始化有改进空间，时变力反演又暴露单一衰减状态的表达缺口；这两种解释需要分别检验。 | [初态与结构对照](originals/accepted/0027_memory_oracles.md)、[非中心化对照](originals/accepted/0030_uncentered_oracle.md)、[方案全表](catalog.md) |
| 局部模态、能量界与真实系统安全是什么关系？ | 冻结 M3 的局部谱与保守能量界各有明确数学对象；全阶谱还经历了约化伪模态的纠正。这些证据保留各自 ROM 范围和覆盖条件。 | [模态审计](originals/accepted/0035_m3_modes.md)、[能量界](originals/accepted/0036_m3_energy_boundary.md)、[方向相关边界](originals/accepted/0037_m3_reachable_boundary.md) |
| 轨迹改善是否足以通过完整评价？ | Pilot 的正式 test 检查中，轨迹相对贡献通过，而新增失稳漏检使联合主张未通过；该 test 随后已消费，不能用于新模型选择。 | [原确认记录](originals/failed/0038_private_confirmatory.md) |
| 闭合误差应归于表示、参数还是初始化？ | 后续空间力投影、隐状态阶数和联合训练记录逐项检查这些解释。例如 0064 支持其冻结 train 条件下以已有作用空间内的失配为主，不能外推为所有模型都应维持同一状态维数。 | [物理力投影](originals/accepted/0064_physical_force_projection.md)、[隐状态阶数](../../accepted/0059_latent_order_audit.md)、[长时程记录](../../accepted/0060_long_horizon_campaign.md) |
| 同一梯度结构通过实现检查，是否已经完成结构发现？ | 0076 接受的是实现与模板表达能力检查。后续系数、局部稳定性和模态平衡诊断仍需按各自冻结对象解释，不能由一次诊断直接宣布模型晋升。 | [结构原型](originals/accepted/0076_structure_prototype.md)、[复方向模态平衡](originals/accepted/0097_complex_balance.md) |

上表直接引用原报告。本次没有重算指标、加载模型或重新读取原始数据；也没有把后来已暴露的数据重新标为独立确认。

这部分进一步区分优化充分性、数值资格与初态推断。以下是原决定的阅读摘要，没有重新评价或选择模型。

- **数据、代码或基线接受**：说明对应合同或检查通过，不能自动扩大成预测和泛化结论。
- **诊断接受**：可以排除或加强一个限定的竞争解释，未必改变模型参数或采用决定。

- **实现偏离、优化状态或资源检查未通过**：原记录有单独身份，不统计成一次有效的科学比较。

# Result status

This directory preserves the historical e-series artifacts. It is not the current
model registry: use [current research state](../docs/current_state.md) for active
baselines, experiments and fresh/consumed TEST identities.
See the [retention audit](../reports/records_retention_audit_20260922.md) for scope
and dependencies. The 2026-09-22 cleanup preserves all numerical files and paths;
some legacy artifacts remain inputs to regression tests and historical figures.

## Corrected historical development evidence (e10–e15)

The accepted `e10_refit_v2`, `e11_modal_validation_v2`, and `e12_refit_audit`
directories contain the corrected five-fold refit, final-model modal diagnostic,
and event-derived audit summary. They are post-selection validation evidence.
Strict H100 covers only 177 stable events; 35 unstable events are excluded.
Modal evaluation succeeds for 167/177 eligible stable events. See the audit in
`reports/accepted/0010_project_conclusion_audit.md` for negative findings and limits.

`e13_failure_diagnosis` and `e14_force_balance` are accepted frozen-model
diagnostics (loops 0011/0012), not improved checkpoints. F1 has static cut-capacity
violations; F5's large dynamic errors remain after smaller integration steps,
observed future Pm, or zero hidden initialization. Zero initialization reduces
pooled error but worsens event-median error in both audited folds. Neither
diagnostic establishes a deployable repair or a stability certificate.

`e15_electrical_balance` (loop 0013) substitutes offline terminal Pe in a swing
impulse audit. This reduces the residual for many F5 cases but is not a forecast:
the source equation uses electromagnetic torque te, and the Pe substitution
leaves damping, armature losses and sampling effects unresolved.

## Pre-fix and exploratory snapshots (e00–e09)

The legacy e00–e09 numerical files predate Git baseline `f764fe0`. They are
retained as immutable audit inputs, not as results reproduced by the current
code.

In particular, the historical pruning outputs were generated before the
physical-horizon and total module-adoption fixes accepted in loop 0001. They
must not be promoted as current evidence. A future accepted experiment must
write a new run directory, record the starting commit and data identity, and
pass the gates in `docs/engineering_loop.md`.

Loop 0002 also established that historical fields named `certified`,
`critical_energy`, and `margin` came from local SLSQP/root candidates rather
than a verified global escape-energy lower bound. They are retained only as a
retrospective heuristic screen. They do not support a formal stable verdict or
a safety guarantee.

Ten inherited JSON files contain Python-style `NaN` or `Infinity` tokens. The
current JSON gate reports these Python extensions as warnings rather than
rejecting inherited snapshots. They are not rewritten, because doing so would
alter the snapshots' recorded provenance. New accepted artifacts must use
standard finite JSON values or explicit `null` plus a documented status field.

The historical E5/E5b/E5c modal headline is also not confirmatory: it evaluates
validation events that participated in model selection, uses pre-final full
models in several folds, and reports a per-event best-match statistic. The
replacement protocol uses final pruned models and all pairs from a complete
Hungarian assignment, macro-aggregated by event; it remains a post-selection
validation diagnostic until confirmed on a fresh holdout.

The historical E6b/E6c/E8 outputs came from multiple reads of the same test
build. That build is listed as contaminated in `configs/test_release_v1.json`
and cannot be re-armed as a confirmatory release.
